title: Human meningioma culture

publications.title: Transglutaminase 2 expression is increased as a function of malignancy grade and negatively regulates cell growth in meningioma.

institution: Department of Neurology / Department of Neurosurgery, Chang Gung Memorial Hospital at Linkou, Chang Gung University College of Medicine, Taiwan
platform: Affymetrix Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0 Array (GPL570)

normal_control_tissue.type: primary cultures of non-neoplastic arachnoid membrane, grown under the identical culture protocol as the tumor samples

needs_manual_review_reason: DEEP-AUDIT (2026-07-14): publications[0].authors was truncated to exactly 6 names; expanded to the full 10-author Europe PMC authorString for PMID 25247996 (Huang YC ... Gutmann DH, Yeh TH), which confirms Yeh TH as the last author, consistent with the already-verified sole corresponding author (Tu-Hsueh Yeh, do2739@adm.cgmh.org.tw per PMC4172767, corrected in the 2026-07-12 pass). No further correspondence, grade, or outcome-data discrepancies found. RULE 13 JUDGMENT CALL, flagged explicitly per instructions: all 24 individual GSM records were fetched and read in full. Series_overall_design states '24 primary meningioma cultures from surgical specimen were maintained to primary meningioma cultures' and every GSM's growth_protocol field reads identically: 'Meningioma samples were acquired from surgical specimens, then were maintained in DMEM with 10% FBS.' Per-sample 'cell type' is uniformly 'primary meningioma culture' (or 'primary...culture' for the 3 arachnoid controls) with a per-sample 'tumor grade' field (values: arachnoid x3, WHO grade I x18, WHO grade II x3). There is NO mention anywhere in the series or any of the 24 samples of an established/immortalized cell line name (e.g. IOMM-Lee, Ben-Men-1, KT21-MG1, HBL-52, the immortalized lines this project has excluded to /data/adjacent/ elsewhere), no passage number suggesting long-term immortalization, and no viral transformation/SV40/hTERT language. This reads as genuine short-term primary culture directly from resected tumor tissue (real WHO-graded patient tumors, individually graded), one step removed from raw tissue but not an established cell line -- consistent with this project's stated standard that some cultured-tissue studies remain in-scope. Judgment call made: KEPT IN CORE (/data/), not /data/adjacent/, but flagging explicitly so a human can double-check this reasoning. Full grade tally (verified against all 24 GSM records, not a partial sample): 3 arachnoid (non-neoplastic) controls, 18 WHO grade I, 3 WHO grade II, 0 WHO grade III. tissue_preservation set to 'not_applicable' (cultured cells, neither fresh-frozen nor FFPE tissue) and treatment_timepoint_status set to 'Not applicable', mirroring this project's existing convention for cultured/cell-derived records (see e.g. gse-282351-methylation.json in /data/adjacent/). Publication (PMID 25247996, Huang et al., PLoS One 2014, Transglutaminase 2 / TGM2 study) confirmed via PubMed full abstract fetch, which states verbatim 'we performed microarray analyses on 24 primary cultures from 21 meningiomas and 3 arachnoid membranes' -- an exact match to this series' sample composition, giving high confidence in this publication link despite no Series_pubmed_id being present in the GEO record itself. large_cohort left false pending centralized quartile recomputation.
